item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We believe that future is within reach—and we’re working to make its benefits universal.

2. We believe superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will make every person on Earth wealthier than the richest 1% are now. That’s the scale of possibility before us: abundance shared by all.

3. A future where everyone is wealthier than today’s richest 1% is possible. We believe superintelligent AI, built within the next 20 years, will make it real for every person on Earth.

**(b) Newsletter opening (104 words)**

We stand at the edge of a transformation that can change life for everyone. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. We believe this plainly and completely: the extraordinary capabilities of superintelligence can create abundance on a scale humanity has never known, and that abundance can reach every person. This is not a future reserved for a few or a promise of modest gains. It is a vision of universal prosperity, where every community shares in the gains of powerful technology. We are here to help bring that future into view—and make it real.
